Qf_comparison.criterion: max minus min smaller than the supplied +/-0.1e11 half-spread; not the full 0.2e11 band

radiative_check.formula: dT/dt = -2 eps sigma (T^4 - T_env^4) / (rho cp d), T in kelvin
radiative_check.implementation: The four histories use the prompt's knots exactly. Their final 25 C endpoint is an assumed tail, not the exact radiative solution (about 38.1 C at 300 s). The equation approaches 25 C asymptotically. Slow cooling is the prompt's phenomenological 5x time scaling.

provenance.number: 400 C for 30 min in forming gas

provenance.where: PDF p. 7, explicitly specified for non-cleanroom set; adopted for cleanroom

provenance.number: pull shorter than 5 s in oxidizing gas
5 s travel at 1000 C, dry O2, applied to this cleanroom case
25 C at clean/load/store/metal/CV; N2 throughout preheat; dry O2 begins with the full 8 h clock
A: preheat 1–5 min; PMA heatup 1–5 min; PMA cooldown 5–15 min
B: preheat 60–120 min; PMA heatup 20–40 min; PMA cooldown 30–90 min
emissivity 0.7; wafer thickness 525 um; density 2330 kg/m3; heat capacity 900 J/kg/K; surroundings 25 C
representative durations are range midpoints; hot-push curves use a normalized exponential, tau = duration/5, approximated by 12 linear segments; A PMA cooldown uses the same shape

provenance.source: prompt, referencing the paper's 1000 C spread
provenance.where: Table III prints a spread for the 1 h temperature-series row; Table VI's 8 h row has no individual spread

limits: No transition temperatures or durations were fitted to measurements.
Qf starts at the oxidation equilibrium: preheat and forming-gas steps are omitted by its existing model, so their insensitivity is built in.
Dit uses the current fitted hydrogen rate without temperature dependence. Its changes during long forming-gas ramps are model sensitivity, not validated physical kinetics.
The growth model retains its existing 23 nm Deal–Grove intercept; this is not a measured starting oxide. No material parameter was changed.
The paper's 8 h Table VI/VII rows do not give individual spreads; the Qf threshold comes from the prompt and the 1000 C temperature-series spread.
The 32 endpoint combinations sample the specified duration ranges; they are not a proof of extrema over every possible trajectory.
